beats.text: Ye galti tumhare har short ko maar rahi hai aur tumhe pata nahi
Tum video to bana lete ho lekin pehle teen second me hi aadhe log nikal jaate hain
Analytics screen par retention girta hua graph
Isko theek karna mushkil nahi hai bas ek chhoti si aadat badalni hai
Pehle teen second me seedha nateeja dikhao phir wajah batao bas yahi raaz hai
Kal se har video me yahi karna
